service.en: Register interest in a seat at Al Ghad nurseries
service.ar: تسجيل الرغبة بحجز مقعد في حضانات الغد
service.ur: الغد نرسریوں میں نشست کے لیے دلچسپی کا اندراج
service.ml: അൽ ഗദ് നഴ്സറികളിൽ സീറ്റിനായി താൽപര്യം രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്യൽ

about: Let the parent of an Emirati child, or a child of an Emirati mother, register interest in a seat or a move between Al Ghad nurseries.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Parent of an Emirati child or of a child of an Emirati mother
documents: People of Determination card, if applicable
Martyrs Families Office to-whom-it-may-concern certificate, if applicable
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
